### Biography

I am currently a postdoctoral researcher at the **International Audio Laboratories Erlangen**, a joint institution between the Friedrich-Alexander Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg and Fraunhofer Institute for Integrated Circuits. 

My research focuses on the perceptual and cognitive evaluation of how humans experience and interpret spatialized sound. During my PhD, my research has revolved around the perceptual evaluation of spatial audio in complex multimodal interactive virtual reality environments.

### Interests

::: {.interest-tags}
- Auditory Perception & Cognition
- Virtual & Augmented Reality
- Multisensory Integration
- Virtual Acoustics
- Evaluation Methodologies
- Behavioral Evaluation
:::
